description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Language, which manages language-specific data and functions for the HTML Purifier library, including localized messages, error names, and string formatting.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Language
classes.description: A class representing a language with methods to retrieve messages, error names, and perform string formatting for localization purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the language object with configuration and context.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads language data from the language factory cache; lazy loads.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a localized message string by key.

methods.name: getErrorName
methods.description: Retrieves a localized error name by error code.

methods.name: listify
methods.description: Converts an array into a readable string based on localized separators.

methods.name: formatMessage
methods.description: Formats a localized message with parameters, supporting token substitution.
